title: VERAS: Verification-Guided Adaptive Search for Reliable Operations Research
title_zh: VERAS：面向可靠运筹学研究的验证引导自适应搜索

paragraphs.en: 总结：VERAS通过验证引导的自适应搜索机制提升LLM智能体解决运筹学问题的可靠性与优化质量。 Advances in reasoning, coding, and tool use enable LLM agents to solve operations research (OR) problems through iterative problem modeling, program construction, and verification. Yet passing self-authored verification does not ensure that the solutions satisfy task constraints and meet optimization quality. This gap can arise from correlated specification errors, where the generated program and its checks share omissions or misinterpretations of task requirements, alongside incomplete verification coverage and ineffective optimization strategies. We propose VERAS, a verification-guided adaptive search harness for reliable OR that uses verification evidence to prioritize feasibility repair, constraint-coverage review, and solution-quality improvement. VERAS combines task-specific solution checkers with a separate verification agent to examine candidate solutions against the task requirements. It uses verification feedback to guide feasibility repair, additional constraint checking, and objective improvement, while candidate acceptance criteria screen revisions for deterioration in output validity or constraint satisfaction. On ORAgentBench, VERAS achieves a 42.99% pass rate, exceeding the reported 35.51% of Codex using the same LLM. Across two industrial-scale OR problems, VERAS reduces inter-datacenter peak bandwidth by 10.34% relative to native Codex and lowers annualized distribution network planning costs by 6.28% compared with expert-designed solutions. Code and evidence are available at https://github.com/holimario/VERAS.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：VERAS通过验证引导的自适应搜索机制提升LLM智能体解决运筹学问题的可靠性与优化质量。 推理、编码和工具使用方面的进展，使LLM智能体能够通过迭代式问题建模、程序构建和验证来解决运筹学（OR）问题。 然而，通过自编写的验证并不能确保解决方案满足任务约束并达到优化质量。 这种差距可能源于相关的规范错误，即生成的程序与其检查共享了对任务要求的遗漏或误读，此外还有验证覆盖不完整和优化策略低效的问题。 我们提出VERAS，一个面向可靠运筹学的验证引导自适应搜索框架，它利用验证证据来优先进行可行性修复、约束覆盖审查和解方案质量改进。 VERAS将任务特定的解方案检查器与一个独立的验证智能体相结合，以根据任务要求审查候选解方案。 它利用验证反馈来指导可行性修复、额外的约束检查和目标改进，同时候选接受标准用于筛查输出有效性或约束满足方面的退化。 在ORAgentBench上，VERAS达到了42.99%的通过率，超过了使用同一LLM的Codex所报告的35.51%。 在两个工业规模的运筹学问题上，VERAS相较于原生Codex将数据中心间峰值带宽降低了10.34%，与专家设计的方案相比将年化配电网规划成本降低了6.28%。 代码和证据可在 https://github.com/holimario/VERAS 获取。
